coins.name: Starlet Motel
coins.description: A roadside motel with a flickering neon sign, a drained pool and a parking lot that has seen things. The roadside hideout that started it all. Fan-made concept listing in the Dynasty 8 catalogue. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Not an official or purchasable GTA VI property. Speculative digital collectible; it does not represent ownership of any real or in-game property.

feeSharing.setup: After the Pump launch: register the mint, then /admin/treasury -> 'Fee sharing for a launched coin', signed by creatorWallet (sweep if needed, create_fee_sharing_config, update_fee_shares_v2; locks the split).

coins.registration: POST /api/admin/properties/starlet-motel/token {mintAddress, creatorWallet} -> PENDING_VERIFICATION, then POST /api/admin/tokens/{id}/verify -> LIVE. Only registered mints count toward the fund.
pending: D-LAUNCH-DEVBUY: initial buy size (0 by default).
Square crop of the 3:2 property artwork for Pump's coin image.
